text: Childminder here, been waiting over an hour for a callback so messaging. Boy, 10, temp 38.3. He's got a rash on his chest but I did the glass test and it goes pale, fades right away. Between doses of ibuprofen he's running about, drinking juice, chattering away no problem. Parents can't get here till late and I need to know whether this is a home-and-watch thing or not, because I'm not sitting by the phone all night again
